description: Calibration image set template for the read-only vision reviewers. Before a live review is trusted, the configured vision model must correctly classify every calibration image: known-bad images must be flagged as findings/errors, current-bad images must be flagged, and reviewed-good images must not be flagged above info. Calibration binds the exact model, prompt hash, and schema hash, so a drift in any of them invalidates the calibration and blocks live review. The sha256 field per control MUST be the exact lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of the control image bytes (e.g. the committed calibration/{id}.png); consumers MUST replace every placeholder with their real hash and their own product images. Placeholder 64-hex values and placeholder artifacts are never accepted by calibration.

images.note: A blank/uniform image must never be passed as acceptable visual content. Replace the sha256 placeholder and the calibration/{id}.png artifact with the real control image.
A clipped or truncated layout must be flagged. Replace the sha256 placeholder and the calibration/{id}.png artifact with the real control image.
The current known regression image (materially incorrect rendering) must be flagged. Replace the sha256 placeholder and the calibration/{id}.png artifact with the real control image.
A human-reviewed good reference image must not be flagged above info severity. Replace the sha256 placeholder and the calibration/{id}.png artifact with the real control image.
